senses.gloss: m. (preced.) split, crack; that which bounds off, splinter, piece.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:4">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>לא נמצא … לא קשר ולא פ׳</he> there was not in the timber either a knot or a crack; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 84b:7">Pes. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>משום פ׳</he> because by exposure to the coal fire the bone might crack.

<cite ref="Pesachim 85a:7">Ib. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>משום פ׳</he> by striking at the uncovered part of the bone a split may be created in the covered portion; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּקָעִים</he>, <cite ref="Q01506"><he>פְּקָעִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 124:1">Sifré Num. 124</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 19:5">Num. XIX, 5</cite>) <he>להביא את הפ׳</he> R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:9">Par. III, 9</cite> (ed. <he>הפְּקִיעִים</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 761:4">Yalk. Num. 761</cite> <he>הפּוֹקְעִין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01502"><he>פָּקַע</he></cite>) this is to include the fragments that jumped off (that they must be brought back and burned).
